us-national.method: Public Menggy presentation/pagination of the U.S. News list; publisher page did not return a readable full table.

us-lac.method: Public College Kickstart transcription; include every institution tied at rank 49.

us-global.method: Public XuanXiao transcription, pages 1–7, including every institution tied at rank 299.

cn-double-first.method: All 147 institutions, encompassing the historical 985/211 institutions and their separately listed university identities. Keep original membership names when institutions have since renamed.

hk-subdegree.method: All provider-level isProper=1 entries; child departments are covered by their parent institution. Shared HKCT domain displays both institutional identities.

tw-general.edition: 114 academic year (official snapshot as of 2025-10-15; exported 2026-01-08)
tw-general.method: Official 體制=一般大學 rows. Other university categories are included only if independently selected by another cohort.

us-systems.edition: Official system and administrative-office directories, reviewed 2026-10-19
us-systems.method: Curated U.S. public university systems, community-college systems and central administrative offices. Record the organization and its official headquarters state, not one constituent campus. Per-record evidence documents official identities, domains and locations.

domainReference.method: Exact institution-name/domain alignment with reviewed aliases and official directory corrections; no fuzzy inference in the runtime.

usLocations.method: Use principal-campus directory state; reviewed legal-main-campus overrides for shared/system domains. No user-email geolocation.

canadaLocations.method: Principal campus province, with full province names.
